purpose: Authorize a finite, read-only Stage 6 production/equality verifier in the HEI coordination repository and one bounded eight-registry network execution using the per-registry contracts established by the merged Stage 6 audit. This authority may surface stale or mixed revisions but may not repair, resync, deploy or mutate production.

known_pre_execution_signal.rule: This is a stale-central warning relative to the reviewed repository baseline, not proof of current production state. The Stage 6 network execution must independently read live native and Series production and fail closed if the central descriptor is not equal to the accepted live descriptor. Verification authority does not authorize refreshing the lock.

authorized_coordination_repository_chang: add one bounded read-only HEI Stage 6 verifier script under scripts/
add one bounded HEI verification workflow or extend one verification-only workflow solely to execute that script without production mutation
add a Stage 6 execution report under docs/audits/ containing observations, PASS/FAIL per registry and an explicit central-index result
run ordinary HEI CI on the verifier implementation
run the merged read-only verifier against exactly the eight reviewed production origins
execution_requirements: re-read each reviewed repository main before network execution and stop if a repository has advanced beyond the audited baseline unless the new revision is separately reviewed and recorded before execution
verify native production and Series production in the same bounded execution window for each registry so mixed revisions cannot pass as unrelated observations
HEI: require exact live native build.commit equality to the reviewed expected commit and require Series descriptor/index/envelope build metadata, identity and count equality
MAG: require an explicit reviewed expected build commit and exact live Series descriptor/index/envelope identity/content equality
SOG: require the reviewed native build identity and canonical_data_hash and equal Series build/count/canonical-only facts

CYA: derive current native counts from the reviewed canonical corpus, require exact live build/source revision facts where exposed, and require native/Series build/count/slug-set equality; do not use 119 as a permanent constant
BIR: require exact live canonical content equality against regenerated reviewed repository content plus exact Series record/relationship endpoint equality; do not invent a commit/hash revision

WLR: require exact live wallet/product native-to-Series identity/count/content equality and only the legitimate last_verified_at observable; do not invent build_commit or equate the timestamp with a cryptographic revision
AI Tools: require exact reviewed build_commit across native and Series outputs plus exact identity/count/payload equality
API Deprecation: require exact reviewed deterministic data_revision across native machine and Series outputs plus exact canonical count/safety equality
verify the HEI central Stage 4 registry descriptor index against the accepted live descriptor set after all eight registry checks; stale or mixed descriptor state fails closed
verify Stage 5 relationship counts/sets remain 21/17/1/0/44/161/0/0, total 244, with cross-registry relationships remaining zero

treat missing endpoint, timeout, non-2xx required endpoint, malformed JSON, identity/count/revision/content mismatch, weakened canonical-only/provenance fact, stale central descriptor or mixed-revision observation as FAILURE
record unresolved or weaker facts exactly as audited and never upgrade them to stronger revision claims
forbidden: mutating any vertical registry repository under this authority
mutating production data, deployment state, scheduler, DNS or Cloudflare configuration
refreshing or rewriting the HEI central descriptor lock as part of verification
auto-repairing a stale registry or central snapshot
changing canonical records, Stage 5 relationship semantics/counts, Search, Compare, Stats, UI or localization
creating a universal revision field or weakening stronger registries to timestamp-only verification
automatically continuing from a failed Stage 6 verification into remediation
acceptance: this authority PR contains only this authority file
ordinary HEI pull-request CI is green on the exact authority head
this authority is merged before any Stage 6 verifier implementation or network execution begins
the later verifier implementation is bounded to the eight reviewed origins and audit-defined verification modes
network execution is read-only and produces one explicit PASS/FAIL result per registry plus one central descriptor result
any failure remains a blocker requiring a separate remediation authority rather than automatic mutation
